LESSON: THE BIBLE AS A GUIDE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 2.1: The Bible as a Guide

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: The Bible as a Guide
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should the Bible guide us in daily life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify the benefits of reading the Bible
2. read the Bible always to grow spiritually

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify the benefits of reading the Bible

Teach
• Today’s focus: identify the benefits of reading the Bible.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “identify the benefits of reading the Bible” using a school example.
• Model B for “identify the benefits of reading the Bible” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify the benefits of reading the Bible" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: read the Bible always to grow spiritually

Teach
• Today’s focus: read the Bible always to grow spiritually.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “read the Bible always to grow spiritually” using a school example.
• Model B for “read the Bible always to grow spiritually” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "read the Bible always to grow spiritually" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify the benefits of reading the Bible
• Model 2: read the Bible always to grow spiritually

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify the benefits of reading the Bible
2. Practise: read the Bible always to grow spiritually

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for The Bible as a Guide.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should the Bible guide us in daily life?
